concepts.title: Place value to 1000
concepts.cpaNote: Bundles of tens and hundreds (concrete) → base-10 block pictures (pictorial) → digits in a place-value chart (abstract).

concepts.title: Partitioning numbers to 1000
concepts.cpaNote: Break a quantity into hundreds, tens and ones in different ways.

concepts.title: Add/sub strategies (jump & count-up)
concepts.cpaNote: Empty number line: jump-back for take-away, count-up for difference.

concepts.title: Equal groups → multiplication
concepts.cpaNote: Concrete equal groups → array pictures → × symbol; commutativity via the sideways array.

concepts.title: Sharing & grouping → division; halves, quarters, eighths
concepts.cpaNote: Deal counters out (sharing) vs scoop into piles (grouping); folded paper strip for unit fractions.

concepts.title: Place value to tens of thousands
concepts.cpaNote: Thousand block → Th·H·T·O column chart; every step left is ten times bigger.

concepts.title: Mental & written 2–3 digit addition
concepts.cpaNote: Split by place value, or jump on an empty number line; estimate before calculating.

concepts.title: Mental & written 2–3 digit subtraction
concepts.cpaNote: Count up for close numbers, jump back for chunks, round-and-adjust for near-hundreds; check by adding back.

concepts.title: Term 3 revision sweep
concepts.cpaNote: No new content — mixed retrieval across every concept covered in Term 3.
